output.title: 설정 파일 로더의 자원 누수 수정
output.problem: The config stream was never closed when an exception happened in the loader.
output.analysis: Opening and closing lived in different methods so the failure path skipped the close call.
output.action: Moved the close next to the open and tested the failure path explicitly.
output.result: Tests confirm the stream is closed even when parsing fails.
